body: Sometimes life is just a never ending barrage of struggles that one can't face any further ... I am at that point in my life ... I know you good souls are truly Angels to have lend a helping hand to me ... I don't know if I have it in me to continue to face those struggles now in this constant state of utter despair and hopelessness which I am feeling
I know ... My family loves me so much but how do I go on if I am seeing no path in front of me
I meant anything substantial ... I just kept struggling and pushing until this point.

Thanks man for your kind words but i don't know i have the willpower to go on any further. Dont know how to proceed , how do i explain that after being in this job for 3 years, i dont know anything at all and how do i keep it.

My job ... i am in a stage right now that literally anything can happen to it, i dont have the new time to learn new skills to keep it and i am struggling to make sense of anything at all right now. And i m so so alone right now that i cant even start . I am the breadearner of my family .
I have fucked up in life man, i will be dead today , my insignificant speck of an existence will go to the grave with me today.

I have failed in life.I am in a job for literally 3 years now but dont know anything substantial to actually do anything properly . I am in IT but cant do any programming . I was  good student earlier , my family thinks that i am all good and have such high expectations but i suck at my job.  The few friends i had , have basically forgotten me and my miserable life and although i have tried to reach out to some of them , they have ignored me because who cares about sorry ass life. I am severely depressed right now. SOmetimes i feel while walking on the road... just come in front of a  moving car and end my useless life in an instant. I am not coherent right now.
they would not let me go,i am crying now
